unitName: The Equal Sign and Missing Numbers

cards.back: A number sentence with an equal sign.
Both sides of the equal sign are the same amount.
The two sides are not the same amount.
A missing number in an equation.
The amounts to the left and right of the equal sign.
Yes. 3 + 4 is 7, so both sides are 7.
No. It means “is the same as.”

cards.front: Are the bars the same length?
